design_principles: Do not duplicate extraction already performed by balance sheet, income statement, cash flow or equity ontologies.
Use derive mode for controls that must be populated from canonical outputs in existing statement ontologies.
Do not infer covenant thresholds from calculated financial ratios or management commentary.
Keep reported commitments, pledged assets, secured borrowings, derivatives and contingencies separate.
Preserve reported units, currency, date, scope and sign; normalize only in downstream transformation.

mappings.label: Customer's Name
mappings.definition: Legal name of the reporting customer or entity for which the financial statements are presented.
include: Use the legal entity name presented on the financial statements, cover page or corporate information section.
Retain legal suffixes and the reported language.
exclude: Do not use a subsidiary, auditor, parent, brand, stock exchange or document issuer name unless it is the reporting entity.

mappings.label: Customer Statement Type
mappings.definition: Scope of the financial statements, such as consolidated, separate, standalone, company-only or combined.
include: Use the explicit scope stated in the title or basis-of-preparation note.
exclude: Do not infer consolidated status solely because subsidiaries are mentioned.

mappings.label: Rounding
mappings.definition: Reported scaling or rounding basis applied to monetary values in the financial statements.
include: Capture the scale exactly as reported, then map it to the controlled value.
exclude: Do not derive rounding from the magnitude of values.

mappings.label: Source Currency
mappings.definition: Currency in which the source financial statements are presented.
include: Use the presentation currency explicitly stated in the statements or accounting-policy note.
Return ISO 4217 code where determinable.
exclude: Do not use functional currency, transaction currency or share denomination unless it is also the presentation currency.

mappings.label: Target Currency
mappings.definition: Currency required by the target spreading or downstream system.
include: Extract only when explicitly supplied in the template, instruction or system metadata.
exclude: Do not assume that target currency equals source currency.

mappings.label: Statement Date
mappings.definition: Financial statement reporting date or period end date.
include: For annual or interim statements, use the end date of the reporting period.
exclude: Do not use the auditor report date, publication date, approval date or comparative period date.

mappings.label: Periods
mappings.definition: Number of months covered by the current reporting period.
include: Derive from explicit current-period start and end dates or explicit duration when available.
exclude: Do not default to 12 if the statements are interim, stub-period or cover a changed year end.

mappings.label: Total Assets
mappings.definition: Control total equal to total assets for the current reporting date.
include: Populate from the referenced canonical key in the existing statement ontology.
exclude: Do not independently extract a second value when the canonical statement output is available.

mappings.label: Total Equity & Reserves & Liab
mappings.definition: Control total equal to total equity and liabilities for the current reporting date.
include: Populate from the referenced canonical key in the existing statement ontology.
exclude: Do not independently extract a second value when the canonical statement output is available.

mappings.label: Total Income & Expenses
mappings.definition: Control result from the income statement for the current reporting period.
include: Populate from the referenced canonical key in the existing statement ontology.
exclude: Do not independently extract a second value when the canonical statement output is available.

mappings.label: Unexplained Adj to Ret Profits
mappings.definition: Residual control needed to reconcile opening retained profits, current-period movements and closing retained profits.
include: Populate from the referenced canonical key in the existing statement ontology.
exclude: Do not independently extract a second value when the canonical statement output is available.

mappings.label: Difference
mappings.definition: Balance-sheet reconciliation difference between total assets and total equity and liabilities.
include: Calculate after both control totals have been populated.
exclude: Do not extract a printed subtotal or balancing figure.

mappings.label: Audit Opinion(Stmt Source)
mappings.definition: Type of external auditor opinion expressed on the financial statements.
include: Classify from the formal audit opinion paragraph.
exclude: Do not classify from key audit matters, emphasis of matter, going-concern sections or management statements alone.

mappings.label: Accounting Standard
mappings.definition: Financial reporting framework explicitly used to prepare the statements.
include: Use the explicit framework in the basis-of-preparation or auditor report.
exclude: Do not infer the framework from the country of incorporation.

mappings.label: Accountant
mappings.definition: Name of the external auditor or reporting accountant associated with the financial statements.
include: Use the audit firm signing the report; capture engagement partner separately only if another ontology requires it.
exclude: Do not use internal finance personnel, directors or company secretary.

mappings.label: Analyst
mappings.definition: Analyst assigned to prepare or review the financial spread.
include: Populate from workflow metadata or user input.
exclude: Do not extract a financial analyst named in an annual report.

mappings.label: Statement type
mappings.definition: Frequency or reporting nature of the source statements.
include: Use explicit document title and reporting period.
exclude: Do not equate audited with annual.

mappings.label: Status
mappings.definition: Workflow status of the extraction or financial spread.
include: Populate from workflow state.
exclude: Do not extract corporate status, listing status or going-concern status.

mappings.label: Reconcile To
mappings.definition: Comparative reporting date against which the current-period statement is reconciled.
include: Use the comparative column date corresponding to the current statement.
exclude: Do not use the earliest date in a multi-year summary.

mappings.label: Exchange Rate(Period End)
mappings.definition: Exchange rate applicable at the reporting date for converting source currency into target currency.
include: Extract only an explicitly reported amount matching the defined scope.
Retain the reported date, currency, unit and consolidation scope.
exclude: Do not derive from statement balances or combine unrelated disclosures.
Do not convert nil, not applicable or absent disclosures into numeric zero unless the source explicitly reports zero.

mappings.label: Related Party Transactions

include: Capture the complete relevant disclosure with note number, reporting period, currency, unit, scope and exact source location.

exclude: Do not replace the disclosure with an unsupported summary.
Do not duplicate information already captured under a more specific note key.
Do not infer a numeric zero from silence.

validation_rules.message: Total assets must equal total equity and liabilities.
Target currency cannot be inferred from source currency.

validation_rules.expression: covenant thresholds must have contractual covenant evidence
validation_rules.message: Do not populate covenant limits using actual ratios or computed statement values.

validation_rules.expression: insurance-only mappings require insurance entity applicability
validation_rules.message: Leave insurance-only fields null for non-insurance entities unless explicitly reported.

validation_rules.expression: reported total and components must not be summed together
validation_rules.message: Avoid double counting commitment totals and components.
A field may be zero only when the source explicitly reports nil, zero or no exposure.

validation_rules.expression: all narrative note outputs include source_text and source location
validation_rules.message: Narrative note extraction must be auditable to exact source evidence.

prohibited_behavior: Do not convert blanks, dashes or absent disclosures to zero without resolving the source convention.
Do not populate illustrative dummy values from the template.
